properties.description: Outmarket AI is an insurance technology company based in the United States, founded in 2023, with 40 employees and $21.7M in funding. It offers an AI platform tailored for insurance brokerages, serving over 250 brokerages including Moody Insurance Agency; rapid 300% YoY growth and active recruitment for sales and marketing roles highlight its expanding market presence.
properties.content:
The AI Platform Built for Insurance

250+ agencies trust Outmarket to save 12-15 hours per person each week, grow revenue, reduce E&O risk, and scale expertise across every team.

[Book a demo](https://calendly.com/d/ct5f-25q-ssw)

See exactly how agencies use Outmarket to transform their operations, with hard numbers and real results.

## Outcomes Our Clients Experience

Outmarket delivers measurable impact across every area of your agency - from individual productivity to agency-wide transformation.

hrs

Allow your team to confidently handle lines of business they've never written before. New producers ramp in weeks, not months. AI provides the knowledge; your people provide the relationships.

## Day 1

Love at First Sight

Your team will use Outmarket once and never want to work without it. The first quote comparison, the first gap analysis, the first instant client answer - that's all it takes.

Platform

## One Platform. Every Insurance Workflow.

Less risk, more revenue, and a team that punches above its weight.

Commercial Insurance, Employee Benefits, Loss Run, Data & Insights

#### Quote Comparison

Highlights key differences, premiums, and coverage details across multiple carrier quotes.

#### Coverage Gap Analysis

Evaluates an insured's existing coverage to pinpoint gaps, unaddressed exposures, and propose improvements.

#### Contract Requirements

Compares client policies with contract or lease insurance requirements to identify and flag any deficiencies.

#### Tower Analysis

Analyze complex insurance towers to identify any critical gaps or points of discontinuation.

#### Proposal Builder

Generates a client-ready proposal document in minutes, summarizing coverage, premiums, carrier details, and key selling points.

And many more...

It offers solutions for brokers, wholesalers, and brokers, helping them boost strategic performance and accelerate growth. Outmarket AI has 40-50 employees (+300% YoY), founded in 2023. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States, with an office in Bangalore. Its workforce is distributed across United States and India. Has $21.7M in total funding, with 2 prior funding rounds.

evaluations.criterion: Company sells B2B software or AI to independent small businesses in one fragmented vertical such as dental practices, veterinary clinics, HVAC and plumbing contractors, auto repair shops, law firms, pharmacies, restaurants or trucking
evaluations.reasoning: Outmarket AI markets itself as an AI platform built for insurance brokerages, i.e., a B2B software platform targeting brokerages/agencies. The vertical is insurance brokerages (a fragmented market of independent agencies). Evidence: the homepage proclaims “AI Platform Built for Insurance Brokerages” and “The #1 AI platform for insurance” with 250+ brokerages using the platform; Moody Insurance Agency (an independent, family-owned agency) uses Outmarket AI; PR Newswire press release states the product is “purpose-built for brokerages” and notes hundreds of brokerages as customers. This aligns with selling to independent small businesses within a fragmented vertical focused on brokerages rather than large enterprises. Sources: https://outmarket.ai, https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/outmarket-ai-raises-17m-series-a-to-power-the-intelligence-era-of-insurance-302770379.html, https://outmarket.ai/blog/how-moody-insurance-agency-uses-outmarket-ai-to-level-the-playing-field-streamline-proposals-and-enhance-client-consulting
